name: Guizhou Chitianhua Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guizhou Chitianhua Co.,Ltd. engages in the coal chemical, and pharmaceutical and health businesses in China. The company produces and sells urea, methanol, and compound fertilizers. It also provides medical services, including tumor diagnosis and treatment. In addition, the company engages in the mining and sale of coal, as well as provision of anthracite and thermal coal. Further, it is involved in the manufacture and sales of specialty chemical products; provision of technical development, consultation, exchanges, transfer, promotion, and services; coal washing; sales of coal products; import and export of technology, goods, and pharmaceuticals; motor vehicle repair and maintenance; health…
